The top-level corpus has eight qualifying demand records because every record n06-r01 through n06-r08 has demand_score >= 3, including n06-r06. The downstream job consumed exact hash handoffs of that already-faulty seven-row needs artifact and processed it consistently, so the responsible job is job_1 and the responsible function is normalize.
